verdict.rationale: The only spec evidence is a probe finding an OpenAPI document at the root of developers.cloudflare.com. That is Cloudflare's platform-wide spec, and nothing in the pack shows it describes the Sandbox SDK's API (exec, files, sessions, ports, and so on). A host-platform artifact is adjacent and earns no credit here, and no Sandbox-specific machine-readable spec is documented.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
